pos.settings.v1.GetPOSSettingsRequest.description: GetPOSSettingsRequest reads the current business POS settings.

pos.settings.v1.GetPOSSettingsResponse.description: GetPOSSettingsResponse returns the current business POS settings.

pos.settings.v1.POSBusinessSettings.description: POSBusinessSettings stores business-wide POS experience settings.

business_id.description: business_id is the business id these settings belong to.

business_profile.description: business_profile is one of retail, restaurant, or quick_service.

created_at.description: created_at is when the record was created.

features.description: features are the business-specific POS modules to expose.

receipt_footer.description: receipt_footer is the default footer printed on receipts.

theme.description: theme is the default POS theme for this business.

updated_at.description: updated_at is when the record was last updated.

pos.settings.v1.POSFeatureSettings.description: POSFeatureSettings controls which business-specific POS modules are visible.

cash_drawer.description: cash_drawer enables cash drawer actions and cash movement surfaces.

customers.description: customers enables customer lookup and customer assignment.

gift_cards.description: gift_cards enables gift card selling and redemption.

kitchen_display.description: kitchen_display enables KDS and kitchen preparation workflows.

tables.description: tables enables table and floor service workflows.

pos.settings.v1.UpdatePOSSettingsRequest.description: UpdatePOSSettingsRequest updates the current business POS settings.

business_profile.description: business_profile is one of retail, restaurant, or quick_service.

features.description: features are the business-specific POS modules to expose.

receipt_footer.description: receipt_footer is the default footer printed on receipts.

theme.description: theme is the default POS theme for this business.

pos.settings.v1.UpdatePOSSettingsRespons.description: UpdatePOSSettingsResponse returns the saved POS settings.

get.description: Returns the active business POS settings.

put.description: Updates the active business POS settings.
